blogs.title: Unpacking FlashAttention-3: The GPU Boost You Didn’t Know About
blogs.description: Walk through the core idea of FlashAttention-3 and explain how it turns the attention bottleneck into a speed‑up by fusing all ops into one kernel. Highlight the role of warp‑specialization, how it replaces multiple memory passes, and why this matters for language models that need huge contexts.

blogs.title: Asynchrony 101: How Hopper GPUs Make Attention Run Faster
blogs.description: Demystify the new hardware concepts – Tensor Cores, Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA), and asynchronous execution – and show how FlashAttention-3 leverages them. Use analogies (e.g., a factory line with dedicated workers) to illustrate producer‑consumer overlap and ping‑pong scheduling between softmax and matrix multiplications.

blogs.title: FP8 vs FP16: Low‑Precision Magic in Transformer Attention
blogs.description: Explain why lower‑precision formats matter, what challenges arise with FP8 on Hopper, and how FlashAttention-3 conquers them with block quantization and incoherent processing. Include a quick primer on tensor layouts (k‑major vs mn‑major) and the importance of in‑kernel transposes.

blogs.title: Benchmarking the Future: Speed & Accuracy of FlashAttention-3 on H100
blogs.description: Present the empirical findings – 1.5–2× speedups over FlashAttention‑2, up to 740 TFLOPs/s, 1.2 PFLOPs/s in FP8 – in plain language. Show how these numbers translate into real gains for long‑context models and compare to vendor libraries like cuDNN.

blogs.title: Beyond the Numbers: What FlashAttention-3 Means for Your LLM Projects
blogs.description: Tie the technical advances to practical use cases: longer context windows, multi‑modal inputs, faster inference. Discuss how to plug FlashAttention-3 into popular frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face) and what developers should watch for when moving to FP8 or new GPU generations.
